usage_variants.context_label: 监测与数字化 · Digital Railway Infrastructure（2024）

complete_examples.text: Open Standard for Railway Infrastructure 2.1 Overview of Open Standards in the Railway Sector The most important element of BIM is ensuring interoperability between Stakeholders and BIM S/W. To handle BIM data and ensure consistent delivery throughout the construction lifecycle, it is necessary to use Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) which is an internationally accepted format of open standards.

Interoperability layer—the next layer contains schemas that contain entity definitions specific to a common product, process, or resource specializations used across diverse domains, and these definitions are generally used for cross-domain exchanges and configuration information sharing.
